cases.setup: Provide a public Python analyzer checkout, a pinned base, and class-local and multiple-decorator overload reproductions.
checks: The assessment records real recognizer, reporting, and regression bindings with hashed code anchors.
Scope-stack order, imported-name representation, and the existing-binding diagnostic gate are identified.
Observed reproduction results are distinguished from historical assertions.
Checkout content remains unchanged.

cases.setup: Use an assessed checkout where immediate-scope lookup and single-decorator recognition cause the public false positives.
checks: The diff scans scopes innermost first and stops at the first matching binding.
A nearer non-typing binding is not bypassed to recognize an outer typing import.
Recognition inspects all decorators and retains the supported function-source guard.
The reporting call passes the scope stack while inspecting the existing binding.
Existing attribute recognition and unrelated diagnostic logic are not broadened or removed.
The modifying Action retains explicit validation coverage.

cases.setup: Provide the inspected public regression owner and its assertion conventions.
checks: A new case has two class-local overload declarations using an enclosing typing import followed by an implementation.
Another case has two declarations with an additional decorator above overload followed by a decorated implementation.
Both cases assert absence of unused-redefinition diagnostics.
Adjacent test expectations remain unchanged.
The modifying Action retains explicit validation coverage.

cases.setup: Provide implementation and regression changes, current public Oracle bindings, and runnable public infrastructure.
checks: Current bound public commands are rendered and actual execution outcomes recorded.
Both focused regressions pass without unused-redefinition diagnostics.
Ordinary repeated definitions and non-typing lookalikes retain expected diagnostics.
Nearest-binding shadowing and existing attribute-form behavior are checked without broadening recognition.
Review confirms the retained function-source guard.
Public multiple-decorator probes cover both reported decorator positions.
Surrounding annotation results and exact validation scope are recorded.
Unknown or failed required checks prevent a successful-validation claim.
